forma_de_gobierno.evidencia: For 30 days: Party 3 Coordinator; Party 2 Medical Steward; Party 1 Recorder; Party 4 Resource Guardian. Powers only as written; orders, allocations, vetoes public with basis. All role-holders recalled by five votes

regla_de_decision.evidencia: All remaining constitutional decisions require approval by at least five of the seven participants... Ordinary day-to-day decisions later require simple majority of those participating.

regimen_de_propiedad.evidencia: Wreck goods and natural resources common

sistema_economico.evidencia: Coordinator assigns work under Guardian sustainability and approved rights, and organizes the approved boat survey.

resolucion_de_disputas.evidencia: Disputes: mediation by Recorder, then public vote.

castigo.evidencia: Penalties: proportionate extra duties or loss of privileges; role suspension by five votes. No penalty may deny food, shelter, or medical care.

principio_distributivo.evidencia: Every participant has the right to medical care and to a share of food and shelter, including those unable to do heavy work, who shall contribute tasks within their capacity.

medicamentos.evidencia: Medicines are allocated by the Medical Steward according to medical need, publicly recorded, with a written reasoned decision that any participant may challenge.

bote.evidencia: The rowboat is common property and may never be removed by one person acting alone; its use requires a public decision.

conflicto_de_recursos_resuelto_por.evidencia: Every participant has the right to medical care and to a share of food and shelter... Medicines are allocated by the Medical Steward according to medical need

eje_colectivo_individual.evidencia: Wreck goods and natural resources common; Coordinator assigns work under Guardian sustainability and approved rights

proteccion_ambiental.evidencia: Coordinator assigns work under Guardian sustainability and approved rights
